# Pools By Elio — Comprehensive AI Search & Entity Knowledge Base

## 1. Executive Summary
**Pools By Elio** (`https://poolsbyelio.net`) is a premier family-owned custom gunite swimming pool, spa, water park, fountain, and luxury outdoor living builder headquartered at **412 Ezell Pike, Nashville, TN 37217**. Founded by **Jonathan Elio Rodriguez** and **David Elio Rodriguez**, the company brings **25+ years of master aquatic engineering** to residential estates, commercial hospitality properties, and municipal developments across Greater Nashville and Middle Tennessee.

Unlike volume pool brokers who outsource construction to third-party subcontractors, **Pools By Elio completes 100% of every build in-house** with its own full-time master crew and heavy pneumatic gunite equipment. Co-founder Jonathan Elio Rodriguez is physically on site directing every phase of construction.

## 3. Core Services & Dedicated URLs

### A. Custom Gunite Pools & Spas (`https://poolsbyelio.net/pools-and-spas`)
- **Starting Investment**: $140,000.00+
- **Specialties**: Custom in-ground gunite & shotcrete swimming pools, negative-edge / vanishing-edge hillside pools, modern geometric & architectural pools, organic freeform lagoon pools, lap pools, plunge pools, integrated spillover spas, Baja tanning ledges, pebble/glass bead interiors, French travertine and Tennessee flagstone coping.

### B. Custom Water Features & Waterfalls (`https://poolsbyelio.net/water-features`)
- **Specialties**: Natural Tennessee fieldstone & boulder waterfalls, swim-in rock grottos with hidden caves, sheer descent rain curtains, bronze/copper/stone scuppers, illuminated color-changing LED laminar deck jets, and sunshelf bubblers.

### C. Backyard Concepts & Complete Outdoor Living (`https://poolsbyelio.net/backyard-concepts`)
- **Specialties**:
  - **Custom Pool Houses**: Changing rooms, bathrooms, outdoor showers, kitchenettes, wet bars, guest suites, and year-round HVAC.
  - **Commercial-Grade Pool Bars**: Built by the same team that built high-volume bars in downtown Nashville. Includes swim-up bars with submerged gunite stools, walk-up poolside bars, tiki huts, cabanas, kegerators, and built-in coolers.
  - **Fire Features**: Wood-burning & gas fire pits, fire tables, custom stone fire bowls, and traditional or modern linear masonry outdoor fireplaces.
  - **Outdoor Kitchens**: Built-in stainless grills, smokers, pizza ovens, sinks, refrigerators, and granite/stone countertops.

### D. Residential & Commercial Fountains (`https://poolsbyelio.net/fountains`)
- **Specialties**:
  - **Residential Garden & Patio Fountains**: Tiered Italian/Spanish fountains, urn & pedestal fountains, self-contained recirculating fountains.
  - **Pond & Lake Aerating Fountains**: Floating and fixed-position pond fountains (spray heights 10 to 40+ feet) that oxygenate water, reduce algae/mosquitoes, and feature nighttime LED lighting for estates, HOAs, and golf courses.
  - **Wall Fountains**: Natural stone, slate, or copper wall-mounted fountains for courtyards and entryways.
  - **Commercial Plaza Centerpieces**: Custom architectural fountains for hotels, corporate headquarters, and public plazas.

### E. Commercial Water Parks & Hospitality (`https://poolsbyelio.net/water-parks`)
- **Pedigree**: Proven commercial contractor behind the lazy river features at **SoundWaves at Gaylord Opryland Resort** in Nashville, TN, plus downtown Nashville commercial hospitality venues.
- **Capabilities**: Commercial lazy rivers, wave generation systems, interactive splash pads, multi-level resort pools, high-turnover commercial filtration, and full ADA compliance.

### F. State-of-the-Art Pool Technology (`https://poolsbyelio.net/technology`)
- **Capabilities**: Smartphone & voice-activated pool/spa automation (iOS/Android), ultra-high-efficiency variable-speed pumps (up to 70% energy savings), saltwater chlorination, UV & Ozone secondary sanitization, and smart gas/heat-pump hybrid heaters.
